name: Calendar: Update Imported Feed

description.en: Change an existing iCalendar source for this team's imported updates. Update its source address, timezone, sync state, publishing preference, or safe public properties without changing unrelated calendar sources.
description.de: Ändert eine bestehende iCalendar-Quelle für importierte Updates dieses Teams. Aktualisiere Quelladresse, Zeitzone, Synchronisierung, Veröffentlichungsoptionen oder sichere öffentliche Felder ohne andere Quellen zu verändern.

bot: Use this only after identifying the feed with the list action. Supply only fields the user wants to change; properties replace the full public-properties object, so retain existing values unless the user wants them removed.

inputs.name: Feed ID

description.en: Identifier of the imported calendar source

inputs.bot: The feed ID from list imported calendar feeds.

description.en: New public HTTPS .ics or webcal URL

inputs.name: Timezone
inputs.bot: Optional IANA timezone such as Europe/Vienna.

inputs.name: Sync daily

description.de: Ob die tägliche Synchronisierung aktiv ist

inputs.bot: False pauses automatic daily synchronization. It does not delete already imported updates.

inputs.name: Publish automatically

description.en: Whether new imported events publish immediately
description.de: Ob neue importierte Ereignisse sofort veröffentlicht werden

inputs.bot: False keeps newly imported events as drafts for review.

inputs.name: Public properties
inputs.bot: Optional JSON object replacing the safe public string values. Never include personal or private data.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug that owns this calendar source

inputs.bot: The slug of the team that owns this calendar source. Omit it to use the current team.
